quote: Kawaki rebuilt our website and it finally looks like our work: clean, quiet and all about the projects. What surprised me was the speed. Every stage came back quickly and on time, and Kunal was easy to work with from the first call to launch.
name: Amit Das

quote: We needed our store to feel like a lookbook and still sell like a shop, and Kawaki got that balance right. The site is quick on phones, and Kunal turned our changes around fast at every stage.

Our website finally shows three decades of work properly, from our early projects to the parametric ones. Kunal's team understood architecture, worked quickly and gave each of our services a clear way to enquire.

Our buyers are architects, not shoppers, and Kawaki built the catalogue around how they actually work: specifications, drawings and quote requests. The project moved quickly and Kunal was always easy to reach.
Kawaki brought admissions, attendance, fees and timetables into one portal our staff actually like using. They delivered each milestone on time, and Kunal took our feedback on board straight away.
Kawaki understood that our nurses study on their phones between shifts, and built the platform around that. They were quick, careful with the German content, and Kunal kept every step clear.
The app finally looks like a streaming service instead of old desktop software, and it holds up through long live matches. Kunal's team was fast and responsive throughout.
Our customers now book themselves, and the calendar only offers slots we can really deliver. Kawaki moved quickly and Kunal made the whole project easy.
